t: This is Hampstead Meeting House, the Quaker meeting house at 120 Heath Street. It was designed by Fred Rowntree in the Arts and Crafts style, and Rowntree was himself an Arts and Crafts architect. Before this building, the Friends met in Willoughby Road, from 1903. The Hungarian emigrant sculptor Peter Laszlo Peri was an elder of the Hampstead meeting, and he joined in 1945.
